$comment: Your Story worksheet. The draft is assembled by joining the non-empty answers in order, with each prompt's lead-in.

prompts.label: What brought you in?
prompts.help: Where were you when you first found The Labs? One or two sentences.
prompts.example: I'd just left a job I'd had for eleven years and wasn't sure what came next.

prompts.label: A moment that stuck
prompts.help: One specific moment. What happened, who was there?
prompts.example: In my first Build Cycle, our Pod interviewed library staff, and I realized I was good at asking questions nobody else thought of.

prompts.label: Why you keep coming back
prompts.help: What do you get from it now?
prompts.example: I keep coming back because I learn faster with other people than I ever did alone.

prompts.label: Who you'd tell
prompts.help: Optional. Who do you think it's for?
prompts.example: If you're figuring out what's next, it's a good place to start.

examples.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Past Build Cycle participant
examples.text: Last year I was job hunting after a long time in one role, and I was learning AI tools alone at night. A friend brought me to a workshop at the library. Three months later I'd built a working prototype with four people I'd never met, and I presented it to a full room. I keep coming back because I learn faster with other people. If you're figuring out what's next, come to one workshop.

examples.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Mentor
examples.text: I've worked in design for fifteen years, and I wanted to give back in a way that wasn't another panel. At my first Labs session, a Pod was stuck on how to interview people without leading them. We worked it out in twenty minutes, and they used it for the rest of the cycle. That's why I stay: small help, at the right moment, goes a long way.

examples.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Library partner
examples.text: Our branch runs a lot of programs, but few that bring strangers together to build something. When The Labs started meeting here, I watched people who'd come in alone leave as a team. That's what a library is for. Now I tell anyone who asks what's on: come Thursday, it's free, and you'll meet people.
